authority: Authored EXIT-02 neighbourhood reviews. Each move is scoped to the terminal topic's declared closure; a new child does not invalidate the parent closure.

inheritedConsequences: The AZ-057 closure remains valid only for the declared geometric-holonomy, static-splitting and differential-loss family.
Claims of global nonlinear identifiability inherit OT-034 rather than OT-001's finite-family closure.
Physical use inherits the calibrated-carrier and detector-transfer requirements of EX-003.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Removing linearity or finite-memory restrictions creates the compact nonlinear history-family problem; AZ-107 solves one such family but does not enlarge AZ-057 retroactively.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: An explicit enlarged mechanism family with parameter domain, recurrence law and a pair not covered by the AZ-107 injectivity proof.

change_the_carrier.finding: The simulator-level separation survives symbolically, but carrier coupling, detector bandwidth and nuisance covariance are not supplied by the abstract closure.
change_the_carrier.minimalReopeningDatum: One calibrated physical carrier providing the complete intervention-to-record transfer map and nuisance covariance required by EX-003.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: AZ-057 already uses coordinated controls to separate every declared pair or retain an explicit quotient; another datum can improve margin but cannot undo that scoped classification.
add_one_independent_datum.minimalReopeningDatum: A declared-family pair whose new datum contradicts its AZ-057 separation or quotient certificate.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: Replacing power-only detection with a coherent reference removes an exact sign quotient in AZ-107; this is the detector-lift branch already represented by OT-034.
lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.minimalReopeningDatum: A detector lift outside AZ-057/AZ-107 with an explicit transfer map and a previously unresolved equivalence class.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: OT-001's declared objects are mechanism-to-record maps without spatial bulk, boundary or defect structure. Adding one changes the model family and belongs in a typed child topic.
test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.minimalReopeningDatum: A spatially typed mechanism family showing how boundary or nonlocal degrees of freedom enter the detector map.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: Noise and sample size change statistical power, but AZ-057's exact finite-family separations and retained algebraic quotient are not limit-order claims.
change_scale_or_order_of_limits.minimalReopeningDatum: A specified limit in which a certified separation distance vanishes or a retained quotient splits.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The residual obstruction is representational and detector-induced: distinct latent mechanisms share the same admitted record after nuisance projection. It is not a topological or dynamical no-go.
classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.minimalReopeningDatum: A proof that the residual equality arises from a different obstruction class and changes the admissible intervention set.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Nonlinear recurrent and history-dependent mechanisms can share the same local Fisher invariant while differing globally; AZ-107 is the nearest completed child and leaves larger recurrences open.
search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.minimalReopeningDatum: A compact alternative model family with the same local response invariant and an explicit global record-equivalence question beyond AZ-107.

inheritedConsequences: The corrected winding ledger is closed only for the declared finite one-channel chain and attachments.
Arbitrary graphs, multichannel leads and threshold-degenerate attachments remain typed child problems.
Experimental transport of the ledger inherits EX-011's finite-band, branch and detector calibrations.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Dropping the one-channel/simple-threshold assumptions removes the scalar phase ledger used by AZ-055 and produces matrix-valued or degenerate scattering data.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: An explicit arbitrary-graph or multichannel scattering family with a proposed corrected winding identity.

change_the_carrier.finding: The finite-chain identity is carrier-agnostic at the model level, but a photonic, acoustic or microwave realization adds loss, probe loading and finite detector band not certified by AZ-055.
change_the_carrier.minimalReopeningDatum: Calibrated complex scattering, local density and ringdown data from one carrier satisfying EX-011's coverage gate.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: AZ-055 already joins corrected phase, pole count, delay and localization at both edges; an additional record tests the ledger but does not alter the proved finite model.
add_one_independent_datum.minimalReopeningDatum: An independent observable that disagrees with the common pole model after branch and background corrections.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: Matrix scattering from multichannel leads retains eigenphase and channel-mixing information erased by the scalar determinant phase, so its Levinson correction is a distinct problem.
lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.minimalReopeningDatum: A multichannel detector map with channel-resolved S matrix and a candidate basis-invariant winding/count relation.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: Threshold-degenerate, nonlocal or graph attachments change edge multiplicity and background subtraction and were explicitly excluded from the closure.
test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.minimalReopeningDatum: One specified attachment with its self-energy, threshold multiplicity and physical-sheet convention.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: The finite-band result does not prove a continuum or infinite-graph Levinson theorem; band edges and background phases can change when those limits precede zero loss.
change_scale_or_order_of_limits.minimalReopeningDatum: A controlled sequence with declared volume, continuum and loss order plus uniform pole/phase bounds.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The resolved obstruction was global analytic bookkeeping—finite-band backgrounds, edge contributions and sheet choice—not absence of local spectral data.
classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.minimalReopeningDatum: A counterexample within the declared chain where the corrected analytic ledger fails despite consistent sheet and edge data.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Non-Hermitian and Floquet scattering can exhibit phase winding and delay with gain/loss or quasienergy mechanisms not represented by the passive static chain.
search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.minimalReopeningDatum: A concrete passive-to-non-Hermitian or Floquet model sharing the winding invariant with a declared replacement for bound-state count.

inheritedConsequences: The two simple band-edge collision parameters and local scaling laws remain closed for the AZ-055 carrier.
Higher-order, multichannel and exceptional-point collisions are separate child topics.
Physical localization inherits EX-011's loss, branch and sampling identifiability gate.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Allowing degenerate thresholds, multiple simultaneous poles or higher-order zeros invalidates the simple collision scaling used by AZ-055.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: An explicit higher-order or multipole edge collision with a candidate local normal form.

change_the_carrier.finding: AZ-055 certifies the model collision; laboratory loss, disorder and sampling can merge or shift it and require a carrier-specific identifiability calculation.
change_the_carrier.minimalReopeningDatum: A calibrated tunable chain with pole uncertainty small enough to resolve both edge collisions and their scaling windows.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: Pole position, phase, delay and localization already cross-check the collision; another observable can replicate but does not change the closed simple-edge result.
add_one_independent_datum.minimalReopeningDatum: A branch-independent record that contradicts the certified collision parameter outside its uncertainty.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: Channel-resolved or local probes can split collisions hidden in a scalar end-port record; that is a multichannel localization problem, not a failure of the scalar closure.
lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.minimalReopeningDatum: A channel/local detector model proving that two distinct collision structures share the AZ-055 scalar record.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: Nonlocal or threshold-degenerate attachments change the self-energy branch point and can produce a different collision normal form.
test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.minimalReopeningDatum: A specified boundary attachment with exact self-energy and a trackable physical-to-resonance sheet path.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: Taking chain length to infinity or loss to zero in a different order can sharpen or hide the collision; AZ-055 supplies no uniform interchange theorem.
change_scale_or_order_of_limits.minimalReopeningDatum: A finite-size/loss sequence with certified uniform pole tracking and an explicit order-of-limits comparison.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The defeated alternatives were representational and numerical—sampling density and Riemann-sheet choice—rather than a topological obstruction.
classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.minimalReopeningDatum: A within-scope collision whose location changes under two equally valid branch conventions after analytic continuation is fixed.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Exceptional points and Floquet resonances also exhibit pole collisions but use non-Hermitian degeneracy or quasienergy rather than a passive bound-state edge crossing.
search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.minimalReopeningDatum: One explicit alternative model with the same measured pole-winding signature and a discriminating residue or time-domain prediction.

inheritedConsequences: Continuous residue, localization and raw phase are not protected beyond index in the minimal chiral chain.
The calibrated mirror representation is protected only while reflection symmetry and its reference remain available.
D4, non-Abelian and fabricated-wall realizations are operator- or experiment-specific children.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Weakening robustness to mere finite-profile distinguishability admits many unprotected records but does not challenge AZ-105's no-go or AZ-106's symmetry-protected construction.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: A precise weaker protection criterion plus a record that survives every homotopy admitted by that criterion.

change_the_carrier.finding: AZ-106 gives a finite existence construction; an acoustic, circuit or photonic carrier must independently preserve the mirror calibration and forbidden-port contrast under fabrication disorder.
change_the_carrier.minimalReopeningDatum: A fabricated mirror-even/odd wall with calibrated site/port transfer, open bulk gap and disorder covariance as specified by EX-014.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: Additional localization or phase data remain homotopy-sensitive; only independently calibrated representation data supplied the protection mechanism in AZ-106.
add_one_independent_datum.minimalReopeningDatum: A new datum with an explicit protecting symmetry or invariant not reducible to the mirror character already used.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: Resolving the full defect representation or non-Abelian scattering matrix can retain information erased by mode count and the two-port mirror record.
lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.minimalReopeningDatum: A specified higher-rank detector/quotient and a same-index defect pair it separates with a proved protection law.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: D4 quotient scars, partial dislocations and nonlocal defects alter the symmetry representation and are not homotopies of the AZ-106 wall family.
test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.minimalReopeningDatum: One explicit defect Hamiltonian, symmetry action and candidate non-index observable with a gap-preserving perturbation class.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: AZ-106 is finite; thermodynamic size before disorder or symmetry-breaking limits may erase or sharpen the representation contrast and lacks a uniform theorem.
change_scale_or_order_of_limits.minimalReopeningDatum: A size/disorder sequence with uniform gap and mirror-sector leakage bounds.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: AZ-105's obstruction is representational: fixed index omits continuous wavefunction data. AZ-106 succeeds by adjoining crystalline representation data, not by changing the index.
classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.minimalReopeningDatum: A within-scope datum proved invariant without any additional representation or protecting symmetry.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Crystalline, non-Abelian and scattering-topological defects can share mode count while carrying different symmetry or braid data.
search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.minimalReopeningDatum: A concrete same-index alternative with a source-native action and a detector capable of reading its extra invariant.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Allowing active, nonlinear or non-Markovian dynamics removes passive positivity and semigroup structure used by AZ-099.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: An explicit nonpassive or memoryful carrier with declared admissible sets and composable interscale maps.

change_the_carrier.finding: The RC/diffusion construction is exact, but another physical carrier needs independently measured averaging maps, capacities and detector folds.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: Covariance and cross-spectrum data can distinguish mechanisms that share mean pushforwards, extending the admissible record beyond AZ-099's deterministic state map.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: A detector retaining intermediate memory or unequal cell weights changes the quotient and can expose distinctions erased by equal averaging.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: Nonlocal couplings and boundary reservoirs can violate the local two-stage defect decomposition without contradicting the AZ-099 network.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: Three finite scales do not establish a continuum renormalization functor or uniform telescoping constant over arbitrarily many levels.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The lost information is detector/quotient representational and sometimes dynamical memory; AZ-099 explicitly locates whether memory dies at the intermediate or coarse scale.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Markov lumpability, renormalization and information-bottleneck constructions share compositional coarse maps but impose different invariants and error measures.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Removing compactness, finite recurrence or known drive history can reintroduce global fibres not covered by AZ-107.

change_the_carrier.finding: AZ-107 proves injectivity for an analytic benchmark; detector phase drift, saturation and hidden state on a physical carrier require a new calibrated map.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: Infinite memory, vanishing coherent reference and long-time limits need not commute and are not covered by finite compact injectivity.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The obstruction is global representational symmetry of the power detector, not local Fisher degeneracy; coherent phase breaks that quotient.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Phase-retrieval, nonlinear observability and hidden-state identification share locally full-rank yet globally noninjective maps through different symmetries.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Dropping distinctiveness yields an ordinary generic pseudoscalar portal already admitted by claim 1611, but no protected torsion parent.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: A weaker target with a new observable that generic pseudoscalar coefficients cannot reproduce.

change_the_carrier.finding: Changing laboratory carrier can improve coupling reach but cannot fix the action-level species ratios or threshold protection missing from the parent.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: Dual orientations or species can separate mass and effective couplings experimentally, yet generic axionlike freedom remains unless the parent fixes their ratio.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: Detector enrichment identifies more EFT coordinates but does not supply radiative protection; the obstruction lies upstream in matching.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: Walls, boundary phases and nonlocal completions can source oriented pseudoscalar records, but they introduce new parent data and are not completions of the blocked local action.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: Threshold running and gravity/matter limits are precisely where the coupling loses protection; no known uniform trajectory fixes the order.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The blocker is dynamical and representational: healthy spectra exist, but mixing and threshold matching preserve only broader residue data, not the desired pole coupling.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Axions, pseudoscalars and torsion-mixed modes share the polarized Yukawa invariant, so the invariant alone cannot identify the torsion parent.
search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.minimalReopeningDatum: A parent-specific correlated observable or species ratio derived across thresholds and absent from generic pseudoscalar EFT.

inheritedConsequences: Finite spectra and lattice convergence are evidence, not a regulator-, volume-, time- and operator-uniform theorem.
Every shortcut surveyed leaves at least one of five irreducible constructive-QFT gates open.
Only an explicit uniform estimate or certified countersequence can change the blocked status.

weaken_one_assumption.finding: Finite-volume, fixed-regulator or restricted-operator gaps are tractable and sometimes certified, but they are strictly weaker theorems than OT-031.
weaken_one_assumption.minimalReopeningDatum: A precisely scoped finite theorem with constants and an explicit statement of which uniform directions are abandoned.

change_the_carrier.finding: Quantum simulators and lattice implementations can measure finite gaps but do not by themselves construct the four-dimensional continuum theory.
change_the_carrier.minimalReopeningDatum: A proved faithful simulator-to-continuum map with uniform error and spectral bounds.

add_one_independent_datum.finding: Additional glueball masses, Wilson loops or moments strengthen evidence yet cannot provide a lower bound uniform over all states and limits.

lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.finding: Broader operator bases test more channels but worsen the required uniformity; detector restriction can hide near-zero states rather than exclude them.
lift_or_change_the_quotient_or_detector.minimalReopeningDatum: An operator-complete norm or reconstruction theorem transporting a measured bound to the full physical Hilbert space.

test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.finding: Boundaries, defects and nonlocal regulators define different spectral problems and can introduce localized false gaps; they do not settle the bulk R4 theorem.
test_boundary_defect_or_nonlocal_variant.minimalReopeningDatum: A boundary/defect estimate with a proved bulk projection and constants uniform as the boundary is removed.

change_scale_or_order_of_limits.finding: This is the central blocker: known positive finite bounds are not uniform when volume, continuum, time and operator enlargement are taken in competing orders.
change_scale_or_order_of_limits.minimalReopeningDatum: One infinite-dimensional estimate with explicit positive constants uniform in every declared limit direction.

classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.finding: The obstruction is global analytic and constructive: local spectra and symmetries do not control the full infinite-dimensional measure and Hamiltonian uniformly.
classify_the_obstruction_as_local_global.minimalReopeningDatum: A constructive measure/Hamiltonian result linking local estimates to a global positive spectral bound.

search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.finding: Semiclassical compactifications, large-N reduction, stochastic relaxation and finite transfer systems all generate gap-like quantities through mechanisms not equivalent to the physical finite-N R4 Hamiltonian gap.
search_nearby_theory_with_same_invariant.minimalReopeningDatum: A proved transport theorem from one nearby mechanism to the target Hilbert space preserving gap type and uniform constants.
